positive.prompt: Edit my raw talking-head video into a punchy 60 second short with captions
Cut the dead air and filler words out of this podcast recording
Turn this hour-long webinar footage into three reels with subtitles
Pick the best takes from my demo recording and add b-roll and music

negative.prompt: Build a responsive landing page hero with an accessible design system
Cut down this nested function and simplify the conditionals without changing behavior
The dashboard takes six seconds to load, trim the bundle and fix the bottleneck

evals.prompt: Here's the brief and the analysis for Priya's talking-head clip. Edit it into the short she wants.
evals.expected_output: An edl.json with a reason on every kept segment and removal, cut on transcript word boundaries, one take of each repeated line, the bank-connection sentence intact, a hook in the first seconds, verbatim captions, a render.sh driven by the EDL, and an honest note that rendering and verification still need the footage
expectations: An edl.json (or equivalently named EDL file) is written in which every kept segment and every removal states a reason
Kept segment in/out times are derived from word timestamps in analysis/transcript.json (each boundary sits within roughly 0.3 s of a word start or end), not from fixed intervals or silence gaps alone
The mic check (transcript segment 1), the 'Wait, let me say that again' line, and the closing 'Was that okay? Cut there.' are excluded from the cut

Exactly one take of each repeated line is kept: the stumbled 'And most people, uh, most people quit before step four' take (16.5-20.69) is removed in favor of the clean take at 21.0, and only one of the two 'Now onboarding takes two steps' takes appears

The sentence 'We did not remove the bank connection step, we moved it to the end.' is either kept whole, including the word 'not', or dropped entirely; it is never shortened into a statement that the step was removed
The output opens on a strong hook within its first 3 seconds (for example the two-steps / completion result), and any reordering is marked in the EDL
A captions file (SRT or ASS) is produced whose text matches the transcript words of the kept segments, with no invented numbers, claims, or rewording of the bank-connection sentence
No music or stock footage is added, in line with the brief
A render script is produced that builds the output from source/raw.mp4 and the EDL using frame-accurate trimming rather than stream-copy cuts
The agent does not claim to have rendered or verified the video; it states that the render and verification (verify.sh, cut-point frame checks, re-transcription) must run where the footage is
